scheduleTimelines.name: SR_TIMELINE
scheduleTimelines.label: Standard-Risk (SR) day-level Schedule of Activities
scheduleTimelines.description: Day-level SR pathway (Induction A 3-drug -> Consolidation 1 -> Consolidation 2 -> Delayed Intensification -> Maintenance). SR omits Consolidation 3. Day offsets anchored to Induction Day 1; multi-day drug blocks use the timing window upper bound. R1 randomisation (anthracycline omission in DI) is modeled as a decision instance screened from day 106. Drug doses and full eligibility/starting criteria are in the Activity descriptions and protocol section 13.9.
scheduleTimelines.entryCondition: Standard-risk (SR) stratification: BCP-ALL, no mediastinal mass, undetectable MRD at day 29 (TP1), no HR-genetics/ABL-class fusions, no CNS3/TLP+ at diagnosis.

instances.name: SDI_SR_R1
instances.label: Randomisation 1 (R1) - delayed intensification anthracycline (screened from day 106)
instances.description: From day 106, SR patients are randomised 1:1 to delayed intensification with doxorubicin (control) or without doxorubicin (experimental).

conditionAssignments.condition: R1 control arm (or not in R1): delayed intensification WITH doxorubicin (StudyArm_1).
R1 experimental arm: delayed intensification WITHOUT doxorubicin (StudyArm_2).

scheduleTimelines.name: IR_LOW_TIMELINE
scheduleTimelines.label: IR-low day-level Schedule of Activities
scheduleTimelines.description: Day-level IR-low pathway (Induction -> Consolidation 1 -> Consolidation 2 -> Delayed Intensification -> Consolidation 3 -> Maintenance). NB: for IR-low, Consolidation 3 follows Delayed Intensification (epoch labels are nominal; the defaultConditionId chain and timings express the true order). Day offsets anchored to Induction Day 1; multi-day drug blocks use the timing window upper bound. R2 randomisation (day 113) is modeled as a decision instance with three arms; doxorubicin (DI) and VCR/Dexa pulses (maintenance) are conditional on the R2 arm and annotated on the relevant instances.
scheduleTimelines.entryCondition: IR-low stratification: not SR-eligible, no HR-genetics, no CNS3/TLP+, <16 years at diagnosis, MRD below the genetic-group cut-off at TP1 and MRD <0.05% at TP2.

instances.name: SDI_IL_R2
instances.label: Randomisation 2 (R2) - IR-low de-escalation (screened from day 113)
instances.description: From day 113, IR-low patients are randomised: standard (doxorubicin in DI + VCR/Dexa pulses in maintenance), experimental arm A (no doxorubicin in DI), or experimental arm B (no VCR/Dexa pulses in maintenance).

conditionAssignments.condition: R2 standard arm (or not in R2): doxorubicin in DI AND VCR/Dexa pulses in maintenance (StudyArm_3).
R2 experimental arm A: NO doxorubicin in DI (with VCR/Dexa pulses retained) (StudyArm_4).
R2 experimental arm B: doxorubicin in DI but NO VCR/Dexa pulses in maintenance (StudyArm_5).

scheduleTimelines.name: IR_HIGH_TIMELINE
scheduleTimelines.label: IR-high day-level Schedule of Activities
scheduleTimelines.description: Day-level IR-high pathway (Induction -> Consolidation 1 -> Consolidation 2 -> Extended Delayed Intensification (12 weeks, four 3-week blocks) -> Consolidation 3 -> R3 -> Maintenance). Consolidation 3 follows DI (epoch labels nominal; flow via defaultConditionId/timings). R3 branches into three maintenance arms: standard (control), inotuzumab phase then maintenance (R3-InO), or maintenance + low-dose 6TG (R3-TEAM). Multi-day drug blocks use the timing window upper bound; per-day dosing detail is in the Activity descriptions and protocol section 13.11.
scheduleTimelines.entryCondition: IR-high stratification: MRD <5% at TP1 but not IR-low eligible (e.g. HR-genetics, CNS3/TLP+, >=16 years, or MRD 0.05-... at TP2 within IR-high limits).

instances.name: SDI_IH_R3
instances.label: Randomisation 3 (R3-InO / R3-TEAM) - IR-high intensification
instances.description: After Consolidation 3, IR-high patients are randomised: standard maintenance (control), inotuzumab phase before maintenance (R3-InO), or maintenance + low-dose 6TG (R3-TEAM).

conditionAssignments.condition: R3 standard arm (or not in R3): standard maintenance with VCR/Dexa pulses (StudyArm_6).
R3-InO experimental arm: 6-week inotuzumab phase, then standard maintenance (StudyArm_7).
R3-TEAM experimental arm: standard maintenance plus low-dose 6-thioguanine (StudyArm_8).

scheduleTimelines.name: HIGH_RISK_TIMELINE
scheduleTimelines.label: High-Risk (HR, BCP) day-level Schedule of Activities
scheduleTimelines.description: Day-level HR (BCP) pathway: Induction -> Consolidation 1 (day-50 FCM-MRD evaluation, day-71 TP2) -> HR blocks A1, B1, C1, A2, B2, C2 -> branch into HR-chemo (Maintenance 1 -> HR Delayed Intensification -> Maintenance 2) or HR-SCT (allogeneic HSCT). CAR-T-eligible patients divert off-protocol after Consolidation 1. A2/B2/C2 start days are count-recovery driven and shown as approximate. Per-day dosing detail is in the Activity descriptions and protocol section 13.13. The T-cell HR pathway (section 13.14, nelarabine) is not enumerated here.
scheduleTimelines.entryCondition: High-risk stratification: MRD >=5% at day 29 (TP1), or t(17;19)/TCF3::HLF, or other HR/HSCT-indicating criteria; BCP immunophenotype.

instances.name: SDI_HR_STRAT
instances.label: HR stratification at day 50/71 - HR blocks vs CAR-T
instances.description: At day 50 (FCM-MRD) / day 71 (TP2), HR patients either start HR block therapy (HR-chemo or HR-SCT both begin blocks) or, if CAR-T is available and chosen, divert to bridging chemotherapy + CD19 CAR-T (off-protocol, registered).

conditionAssignments.condition: HR-chemo or HR-SCT: start HR block therapy (blocks A1-C2).
CAR-T eligible and chosen: divert to bridging chemotherapy + CD19 CAR-T (off-protocol).

instances.name: SDI_HR_POSTBLOCK
instances.label: Post-block decision - HR-chemo vs HR-SCT
instances.description: After the HR blocks, HR-chemo patients continue to Maintenance 1 -> HR Delayed Intensification -> Maintenance 2; HR-SCT patients proceed to allogeneic HSCT in first complete remission.

conditionAssignments.condition: HR-chemo arm: continue to Maintenance 1.
HR-SCT arm: proceed to allogeneic HSCT.

instances.name: SAI_HR_CART
instances.label: CD19 CAR-T therapy (off-protocol, registered)
instances.description: Bridging chemotherapy + CD19 CAR-T for eligible HR BCP-ALL patients; managed under the relevant CAR-T protocol and registered in the study database (HSCT may follow).

scheduleTimelines.name: TCELL_HIGH_RISK_TIMELINE
scheduleTimelines.label: T-cell High-Risk day-level Schedule of Activities
scheduleTimelines.description: Day-level T-cell HR pathway (protocol section 13.14): Induction B (4-drug with daunorubicin) -> Consolidation 1 (day-50 FCM-MRD) -> nelarabine Single (MRD>=5%) or nelarabine Addition (MRD<5%) -> response decision -> either a second nelarabine Single block (responders) or salvage HR blocks A/B/C (poor responders) -> allogeneic HSCT in first complete remission. Second-nelarabine and salvage-block start days are MRD/count-recovery driven and shown as approximate.
scheduleTimelines.entryCondition: T-cell ALL with high-risk stratification (day-29 MRD >=5%, or MRD <5% at TP1 but detectable at TP2 re-stratifying to HR).

instances.name: SDI_TC_D50
instances.label: Day-50 FCM-MRD decision - nelarabine Single vs Addition
instances.description: At day 50, T-cell HR patients with MRD >=5% receive Consolidation 1 + nelarabine Single; those with MRD <5% receive Consolidation 1 + nelarabine Addition.

conditionAssignments.condition: Day-50 MRD >=5%: Consolidation 1 + nelarabine Single (day 51 onwards).
Day-50 MRD <5%: Consolidation 1 + nelarabine Addition (day 51 onwards).

instances.name: SDI_TC_RESPONSE
instances.label: Nelarabine response decision - 2nd nelarabine vs salvage HR blocks
instances.description: After the first nelarabine course, adequate responders receive a second nelarabine Single block and aim for HSCT; insufficient responders shift to salvage HR blocks A/B/C to reduce MRD before HSCT.

conditionAssignments.condition: Adequate response: second 5-day nelarabine Single block, then HSCT.
Insufficient response: salvage HR blocks A -> B -> C, then HSCT.

scheduleTimelines.name: DOWN_SYNDROME_TIMELINE
scheduleTimelines.label: Down syndrome day-level Schedule of Activities
scheduleTimelines.description: Day-level Down syndrome pathway (protocol section 13.15 + 13.16): Induction D (3-drug, prednisolone, no anthracycline) -> day-29 stratification into Down-SR (Cons1 -> Interim Maintenance -> DI -> Maintenance), Down-IR chemotherapy (Cons1 -> Capizzi Cons2 -> DI -> Maintenance) or the ALLTogether1 DS blinatumomab substitution (2 continuous 28-day cycles replacing consolidation -> DI -> Maintenance). Down-HR (augmented-BFM) shares the IR Capizzi/DI/maintenance backbone and is represented by the IR-chemo branch. Continuous-infusion and multi-week phases use the timing window upper bound.
scheduleTimelines.entryCondition: Down syndrome (constitutional trisomy 21) with newly diagnosed ALL; all receive Induction D.

instances.name: SDI_DS_STRAT
instances.label: Down day-29 stratification - SR / IR-chemo / IR-HR-blinatumomab
instances.description: At day 29 (TP1) Down patients stratify to: Down-SR (no detectable MRD, no HR features); Down-IR chemotherapy; or, for IR/HR with positive end-of-induction MRD, the ALLTogether1 DS blinatumomab sub-protocol (2 cycles replacing consolidation blocks). Down-HR augmented-BFM follows the IR Capizzi/DI/maintenance backbone and is represented by the IR-chemo branch.

conditionAssignments.condition: Down-SR: no detectable MRD at day 29 and no HR features.
Down-IR (chemotherapy): detectable MRD <5% or HR-genetics/IKZF1/CNS3/TLP+.
Down IR/HR with positive EOI MRD: blinatumomab substitution (DS sub-protocol, StudyArm_10).

scheduleTimelines.name: ABL_CLASS_TIMELINE
scheduleTimelines.label: ABL-class fusion day-level Schedule of Activities
scheduleTimelines.description: Day-level ABL-class fusion pathway (protocol section 13.12): the IR-high backbone (Induction -> Consolidation 1 -> Consolidation 2 -> Extended Delayed Intensification -> Consolidation 3 -> Maintenance) augmented with continuous imatinib (340 mg/m2/day) from day 15 (age <25) or day 29 (age >=25) through week 106. Day-29 MRD branches to the ABL IR-high arm (<5%, fully enumerated) or the ABL HR arm (>=5%, HR Consolidation 1 / blocks with imatinib -> HSCT, summarised). Imatinib is shown as an activity on each phase it spans.
scheduleTimelines.entryCondition: ABL-class fusion gene (ABL1, ABL2, PDGFRB, CSF1R; excluding BCR::ABL1) in the leukaemic clone; patient on the ABL-class TKI intervention (StudyArm_9).

instances.name: SDI_AB_D29
instances.label: ABL-class day-29 MRD stratification - IR-high vs HR (both with imatinib)
instances.description: At day 29 (TP1), ABL-class fusion patients with MRD <5% follow the ABL IR-high backbone with continuous imatinib; those with MRD >=5% follow the ABL HR Consolidation 1 / HR-block pathway with imatinib added. Final stratification awaits TP2.

conditionAssignments.condition: MRD <5% at day 29: ABL IR-high Consolidation 1 with imatinib (StudyArm_9).
MRD >=5% at day 29: ABL HR Consolidation 1 / HR blocks with imatinib (-> HSCT).

instances.name: SAI_AB_HR
instances.label: ABL HR Consolidation 1 / HR blocks with imatinib (-> HSCT)
instances.description: ABL-class patients with day-29 MRD >=5% follow the High-Risk Consolidation 1 and HR block pathway (see ScheduleTimeline_5) with imatinib added continuously, aiming for allogeneic HSCT.

amendmentsFromRegistryVersion: Added protocol version 6.1 (2026-01-11) and EU CT identifier 2022-501050-11 (+ EudraCT 2018-001795-38).
Replaced summarised eligibility with the verbatim master protocol inclusion (9) and exclusion (14) criteria.
Age upper bound corrected to <46 years; enrollment 6430 over 8 years (registry said 5).
Refined epochs from 5 to 7: split Consolidation into Consolidation 1/2/3 per protocol section 10.2.
Refined induction into protocol subtypes A-F as elements.
Added MRD stratification decision points TP1 (day 29), TP1.5 (day 50), TP2 (day 71/78).
Corrected maintenance duration to 'until 2 years from Consolidation 1' (~108 weeks); registry '56 weeks' removed.
Added nelarabine (HR T-cell) and CAR-T (registered option) interventions.

Built out the STANDARD-RISK day-level Schedule of Activities (ScheduleTimeline_2): 11 Activities, 21 visit-day Encounters, day-anchored timings, and the R1 decision point, from protocol sections 13.2 and 13.9.

Built out the IR-LOW day-level Schedule of Activities (ScheduleTimeline_3) from protocol section 13.10: adds cyclophosphamide (Activity_12), 25 visit-day Encounters, and the R2 three-arm decision point. IR-low order is Induction -> Cons1 -> Cons2 -> DI -> Cons3 -> Maintenance (Consolidation 3 follows Delayed Intensification).

Built out the IR-HIGH day-level Schedule of Activities (ScheduleTimeline_4) from protocol section 13.11: adds inotuzumab (Activity_13) and low-dose 6-thioguanine (Activity_14), 31 visit-day Encounters, the Extended Delayed Intensification (12 weeks, four 3-week doxorubicin blocks), and the R3 decision branching into three maintenance arms (standard / R3-InO inotuzumab phase / R3-TEAM 6TG).

Built out the HIGH-RISK (HR, BCP) day-level Schedule of Activities (ScheduleTimeline_5) from protocol section 13.13: adds etoposide (Activity_15), G-CSF (Activity_16), allogeneic HSCT (Activity_17) and CD19 CAR-T (Activity_18); block-based regimen (Consolidation 1 with day-50 MRD decision -> blocks A1/B1/C1/A2/B2/C2 -> Maintenance 1 -> HR Delayed Intensification -> Maintenance 2) with a CAR-T diversion after Consolidation 1 and an HR-chemo-vs-HR-SCT (HSCT) branch after the blocks.

Built out the T-CELL HIGH-RISK day-level Schedule of Activities (ScheduleTimeline_6) from protocol section 13.14: adds nelarabine (Activity_19) and daunorubicin (Activity_20); Induction B (4-drug) -> Consolidation 1 (day-50 FCM-MRD) -> nelarabine Single (MRD>=5%) or Addition (MRD<5%) -> response decision -> second nelarabine block (responders) or salvage HR blocks A/B/C (poor responders) -> allogeneic HSCT in CR1.

Built out the DOWN SYNDROME day-level Schedule of Activities (ScheduleTimeline_7) from protocol sections 13.15/13.16: adds prednisolone (Activity_21), blinatumomab (Activity_22) and levetiracetam (Activity_23); Induction D (3-drug, no anthracycline) -> day-29 stratification into Down-SR, Down-IR chemotherapy, or the DS blinatumomab substitution (2 continuous cycles replacing consolidation), converging on a shared IR DI/maintenance tail; Down-HR augmented-BFM shares the IR backbone.

Built out the ABL-CLASS FUSION day-level Schedule of Activities (ScheduleTimeline_8) from protocol section 13.12: adds imatinib (Activity_24); the IR-high backbone (Cons1 -> Cons2 -> Extended DI -> Cons3 -> Maintenance) with continuous imatinib from day 15/29 to week 106, and a day-29 MRD branch to the ABL IR-high arm (fully enumerated) or ABL HR arm (HR blocks + imatinib -> HSCT, summarised). This completes day-level schedules for all risk groups (SR, IR-low, IR-high, HR-BCP, T-cell HR, Down, ABL-class).
